item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 10)
item.description:
**Player on TV: every control is reachable with the remote** - With the controls hidden, any arrow shows them and lands on Play. Arrows no longer seek. - Left/Right move along a row: the top bar (Back, Quality, Stats, Settings), the seek bar, or the bottom bar. - Up/Down move between rows. Down from the seek bar goes to Play. - Seeking: focus the seek bar's dot and press Left/Right. The jump applies after a short pause, or straight away on OK. - The Quality preset you pick in Settings → Quality now drives Auto's choice.
Windows stays on build 6 for this test release.
